chunks: When the ledgers are laid open

key_terms.الصُّحُفُ: The ledgers or records of deeds
key_terms.نُشِرَتْ: Were laid open or spread out

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the ledgers are laid open on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'spreading of the records' (Nushirat) emphasizes the tangible and undeniable nature of divine justice, where every deed is laid bare for both the righteous and the wicked. This imagery underscores the concept of 'Hisab' (accountability), reinforcing the belief that no action, however small, remains hidden from God's all-encompassing knowledge. The verse serves as a powerful reminder of the ultimate transparency of the Hereafter, encouraging believers to maintain constant self-awareness (Muraqabah) in their daily lives.
